name: Cortex
tagline: Cuts physicians' paperwork with AI records and voice tools, and helps surface rare diseases.

awards: YC x HackPrinceton Challenge by Y Combinator

problem: Physicians spend much of their time on records and paperwork, delaying care, the team argues.
solution: AI agents with retrieval, browser automation and voice calls handle records and data gathering for clinicians.
demo_moment: Team-described: a voice agent completes an intake while the record fills in.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “YC x HackPrinceton Challenge by Y Combinator” among 195 submissions.
Motivated by doctors in low-resource settings.

lessons: Time-saving for clinicians is an easy business case.
